statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, occurring intermittently over the past several weeks.
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10).
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) was billed.
The billed balance for this service is 350.99.
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97.
The denial is based on failure to demonstrate that less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed inadequate prior to initiating this level of diagnostic testing.
